structures.label: Render Buildings
structures.description: Toggles whether buildings are rendered on top of the terrain.

objects.label: Debug Gizmos
objects.description: Displays coordinate markers (map centers, tile boundaries) for debugging purposes.

ground_snap.label: Ground Altitude Lock
ground_snap.description: Constrains the camera focus altitude to the actual terrain height while panning.

dummy_toast.label: Test Toast Notifications
dummy_toast.description: Displays sample toast notifications for UI testing.

ledger_overlay.label: Scheduler Ledger Overlay
ledger_overlay.description: Corner panel showing frame pacing, GPU load, fetch-queue depth and task latency from the world scheduler.

ledger_log.label: Scheduler Ledger Console Log
ledger_log.description: Streams each settled fetch, missed frame and long animation frame to the browser console as it happens.

edge_shade.label: Cube edge shading
edge_shade.description: Darkens only edges that border open air, so flat ground stays seamless and height changes read as a line. Tune with __pxl_edge({ strength, width }).
